verdicts.observation: White Genghis Khan card gives way to a classroom image sliding in from the right edge, with white still showing at left.
endL and startR show the same classroom blackboard 'Largest land empire' with the bearded man; midL is slightly panned.
Classroom blackboard is replaced by a red-and-blue Mongol empire map.
Map is replaced by a medieval town square with fallen heads.
Wide town square with mounted figures becomes a close framing of heads and the market stall.
Close town-square shot becomes a desert scene with mounted soldiers beside three bearded men.
Desert scene with arrows becomes a white card with a horse entering at the left edge.
White 'Mongol horse archer' card becomes a classroom with a painting of an archer on the board.
Classroom board painting differs between midL (dark archer on horse) and endL (colorful riders on plain); then a white card with a tiny globe.
Globe 'Estimated deaths: 40 million' card becomes a '2. The Black Death' title card.
Title card becomes a classroom blackboard reading 1347.
Classroom blackboard becomes a teal map with a small shipping box.
Large 'Plague Express' box on teal map becomes a plain brown planked surface.
Flat brown surface becomes a boxed frame containing several fleas.
Fleas in a box become a classroom blackboard 'The Black Death' with a plague-doctor figure.
Classroom with plague doctor becomes a teal Europe map with a box.
Europe map with an open box and dark spot becomes a blank white frame, then a bacterium card.
Mouse on white shifts to mouse on grey-tan background; midL is the 'Yersinia pestis' bacterium card, endL is the mouse.
endL and startR show the same mouse on a dark wood floor; midR shows a tavern with a bearded man and a tiny mouse.
Close view of bearded man in a tavern becomes a classroom with a painting of a bedridden figure and plague doctor.
Classroom with painting becomes a street with two men holding hands.
Two men in a street become a large close-up of one bearded face on a blurred street.
Face close-up becomes a classroom with a painting and the plague-doctor figure.
Board painting changes between midL (man with cloaked figure) and endL (woman at bedside); then a blurred 'death' word on white.
'death' word on white becomes a teal Europe map covered in small figures.
Europe map with figures becomes a street scene with a fallen head.
Street with one fallen head becomes a different street angle with a plague doctor and two fallen heads.
Close view of plague doctor and fallen heads becomes a white '1. The Toba Supervolcano Eruption' card.
Title card becomes a small globe with a volcano on white.
midL is a zoomed globe with volcano but endL is a small glowing orb on white; startR is a large erupting volcano against space.
Erupting volcano on starry globe becomes a flat red volcano on white.
Volcano with ash cloud and '670 cubic miles' becomes a green landscape with a bearded man.
Landscape with a lava mound and man becomes a sunny sky scene with the man at lower left.
Heavily hazed grey-brown landscape becomes a blank white frame, then a thermometer card.
Thermometer '27F' card becomes a dry brown landscape with a skeletal animal and figure.
Close view of a fallen figure and animal in desert becomes a classroom with a painting of a dead landscape.
Board painting differs between midL (animal on ground) and endL (hazy dead tree landscape); then a green bar chart on white.
endL and startR both show a red block with '3000' on white; midR shows a large cluster of small figures.
Cluster of figures with 'your cousin' label becomes a blank white frame, with an orange sun appearing at midR.
midL shows an orange sun while endL shows 'no second chances' text; startR is a shirtless bearded character on white.
Same character on a background that is darkening from white to light grey to mid grey.
Character on near-black background at endL and black at startR; same pose, fade continuing.
Character on black becomes a sunny blue sky with trees.
Hazed sky fades to a near-black frame, then a dim cave with two figures and a fire.
Cave scene with two figures and fire at endL and startR is identical; brightness rises from midL.
Cave scene with a tall flame becomes a blank white frame, then 'when everything else' text.
midL 'when everything else' text differs from endL large 'DID.'; startR is a classroom with 'subscribe' on the board.

notes: Montages X11-X20 viewed in full, X051-X097 all present. Several SPURIOUS/TRANSITION rows sit at fade or zoom endpoints. hidden_change true for X059, X068, X069, X074, X080, X087, X088, X090, X097 (card or painting swaps inside a state, or midR differs from startR).
